# Eject

> Stop paying to host your website. Move it to your agent for free.

Eject (https://ejectfrom.com) moves a simple website off Webflow, Framer, Wix, or Squarespace onto files you own. After the move, you manage the site with a free ChatGPT account or any AI tool. Eject does not charge monthly hosting.

Operator: Laniakea LLC. Contact: hi@ejectfrom.com.

## Price

- Product: automated move of a simple site
- Price: $99 USD
- Billing: one time
- Not included: your domain registration, which stays with your registrar
- Hosting after the move: Eject does not bill for it. A static host can be $0 a year
- Custom migrations have no public price

## What you get

- The site files. You own the code.
- An editing guide so an AI tool can change the site
- A preview before any DNS change

## Scope

In: simple marketing, portfolio, and landing sites, about 10 pages, on Webflow, Framer, Wix, or Squarespace.

Out: stores, member areas, and large CMS sites.

Eject does not promise that the moved site will look the same.

## Estimate on the home page

Enter a website URL. Eject detects the platform from the public page, then shows a range of published plan prices for that platform. The range is the low and high of checked public prices, not a guess at your invoice. If the platform is unknown, or Eject has no checked price list for it, the page says so and shows the general range of published simple-site plans on Webflow, Framer, Wix, and Squarespace.

Estimated yearly savings is that same range. The $99 fee is one time, so it is not subtracted from the yearly range. Static hosting can be $0. The domain bill does not change.

Price lists were checked on 2026-10-10 from the vendors' own pages.

## FAQ

### What do I pay?

The move is $99 once. After that you can use a free ChatGPT account or any AI tool to manage the website. Eject does not charge a monthly hosting fee. You still pay your domain registrar.

### Do I own the code?

Yes. The files are yours.

### Which sites can move?

Simple marketing, portfolio, and landing sites on Webflow, Framer, Wix, or Squarespace, about 10 pages. Stores, member areas, and large CMS sites are out.

### Will it look the same?

We do not promise a visual match.

### What is the refund policy?

For the $99 automated move, you pay first, we build a preview, and if you don't approve the preview before any DNS change, you get a full refund. The policy is at https://ejectfrom.com/refunds.

### Where are the sample sites?

Sample sites are at https://ejectfrom.com/samples. They are moved template pages, not customer logos.
